headline: Moving home to meet your dated cost
summary: This illustration clears your dearer car loan from spare savings before it combines the remaining savings, working money and the proceeds of moving to a smaller home for your dated cost. It meets both goals while protecting your emergency reserve. You have not told us whether you would consider moving.

parts.does: Today your yearly surplus is {current.position.leftOver}, with {current.position.spareCash} above your emergency reserve.
parts.why: These are today's arrangements, before the home move or money assigned to goals.
parts.gives: Your net worth is {@current.position.netWorth}. Your net worth as a share of assets is {current.position.solvency}; your home accounts for {current.position.homeShare} of your net worth. The recorded pressure point is: {current.position.pressurePoints}.
parts.costs: Keeping everything as it is leaves the dated cost short of funding, even though you have spare savings.
parts.check: Whether your spending, savings and future cost still reflect what you expect.

parts.does: This route keeps assets already assigned to retirement out of the money available for the dated cost: {ledger.crossedOff}.
parts.why: A pension pot cannot also pay a separate bill, and the emergency reserve stays protected.
parts.gives: Including the proposed sale proceeds, cash above the reserve starts at {steps.reserve.cashAfter}, with {steps.reserve.surplusAfter} of working money each year. Clearing the car loan leaves {steps.clear_liability_application_loan_0.cashAfter} of capital and {steps.clear_liability_application_loan_0.surplusAfter} of yearly money. After assigning the remaining cash to the dated cost, the capital balance is {steps.fictional_dated_cost.cashAfter} and yearly money left is {steps.fictional_dated_cost.surplusAfter}. The retirement step adds no further allocation: its capital balance is {steps.goal_application_retire.cashAfter}, with {steps.goal_application_retire.surplusAfter} of yearly money left.
parts.costs: Savings used to clear the car loan and fund the dated cost cannot be spent again. The reserve remains protected.
parts.check: The goal section shows when working money and sale proceeds are paid into the fund.

parts.does: The route protects {position.reserve}, based on {position.reserveMonths} months of essential spending.
parts.why: The reserve supports you before money is assigned to goals.
parts.gives: If you could not work, the calculated yearly income gap is {protection.primary-cannot-work.gap}. {protection.primary-cannot-work.months.notApplicable} If your partner could not work, the gap is {protection.partner-cannot-work.gap}. {protection.partner-cannot-work.months.notApplicable} In the illustration of your death, the gap is {protection.primary-died.gap}. {protection.primary-died.months.notApplicable}
parts.costs: Money protected for emergencies cannot fund the home purchase or your dated cost.
parts.check: Whether essential spending and the income that would continue reflect your circumstances.

parts.does: The recorded borrowing issue is {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.headline}: your {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.liability_application_loan_0.label} has {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.liability_application_loan_0.balance} outstanding at {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.liability_application_loan_0.rate}, with interest at today’s balance of {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.liability_application_loan_0.yearlyCost} a year. Its original end date is {current.issues.debts_other_than_mortgage.liability_application_loan_0.endDate}.
parts.why: The rate comparison is {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.headline}. Today’s spare cash is {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.liability_application_loan_0.spareCash}, earning {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.liability_application_loan_0.cashRateAfterTax} after tax while the car loan costs {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.liability_application_loan_0.loanRate}. On {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.liability_application_loan_0.comparedAmount}, the yearly rate difference is {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.liability_application_loan_0.yearlyDifference}.
parts.gives: Your {inefficiencies.liability_application_loan_0.reason} The separate home-loan comparison is borrowing at {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.fictional_home_loan.loanRate} against cash earning {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.fictional_home_loan.cashRateAfterTax}, on {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.fictional_home_loan.comparedAmount} of today’s {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.fictional_home_loan.spareCash} spare cash. Its yearly rate difference is {current.issues.idle_cash_vs_debt.fictional_home_loan.yearlyDifference}. {moves.change_2.loanRepaid}
parts.costs: Clearing the car loan uses that part of your savings before any money goes to goals. The secured home loan is repaid from the property sale proceeds as part of moving.
parts.check: The car-loan settlement terms and whether any early repayment charge applies. The mortgage retains its own lump-sum test in a route that keeps the home.

sections.title: The home move and your goals

parts.does: {moves.change_2.property} is sold in {moves.change_2.year} and this route buys a smaller home costing {@moves.change_2.newHomePrice}.
parts.why: The dated cost needs more money on time than your spare savings and working surplus provide. Moving is shown as an illustration because you have not told us whether you would consider it.
parts.gives: {moves.change_2.loanRepaid} After that repayment and the transaction costs, the move releases {@moves.change_2.cashReleased} for the dated cost.
parts.costs: Selling costs are {moves.change_2.sellingCosts}. Buying costs are {moves.change_2.buyingCosts}, including stamp duty of {moves.change_2.stampDuty}. The calculated sale tax is {moves.change_2.tax}. Moving also means leaving a home and possibly an area you know.
parts.check: Whether a suitable smaller home is realistic at this price, the actual selling and buying costs, any mortgage break charge, and whether moving is something you would consider.

parts.does: This goal is {goals.fictional_dated_cost.state}. Its funding uses {goals.fictional_dated_cost.chosenWay}, with {goals.fictional_dated_cost.routeCash} of cash assigned in {goals.fictional_dated_cost.routeCashYear} after clearing the car loan. This includes capital released by the home sale.
parts.why: After that cash allocation, the fund needs {goals.fictional_dated_cost.routeYearly} each year during its saving period. Working money supplies that amount.
parts.gives: In {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2026.year}, working money supplies {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2026.yearlyAllocated} and additional capital drawn from the sale is {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2026.capitalAllocated}. In {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2027.year}, working money supplies {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2027.yearlyAllocated} and additional capital drawn from the sale is {goals.fictional_dated_cost.funding.2027.capitalAllocated}.
parts.costs: The cash assigned and the working money saved here cannot also fund another purchase.
parts.check: The amount and date of the cost, and whether the fund's assumptions still fit when the bill is due.

parts.why: The recorded pensions and current funding meet the stated retirement target in this calculation.
parts.gives: This route assigns additional cash of {goals.goal_application_retire.routeCash} and additional yearly money of {goals.goal_application_retire.routeYearly} to retirement.
parts.costs: Pension resources remain assigned to retirement and depend on the stated benefits and calculation assumptions.
parts.check: Your pension statements, retirement dates and the income you expect to spend.

sections.title: What is left in each year

parts.does: While the goal is being funded, money left is {cashFlow.2026.remaining} in {cashFlow.2026.year} and {cashFlow.2027.remaining} in {cashFlow.2027.year}.
parts.why: Funding for {freed.fictional_dated_cost.label}, previously {freed.fictional_dated_cost.amount} each year, ends from {freed.fictional_dated_cost.fromYear}. Clearing the car loan stops repayments of {inefficiencies.liability_application_loan_0.repaymentsStopped} a year from {inefficiencies.liability_application_loan_0.clearanceYear}.
parts.gives: After the saving period, yearly money left is {cashFlow.2028.remaining} in {cashFlow.2028.year} and {cashFlow.2029.remaining} in {cashFlow.2029.year}. Your working income stops in {retirement.primary.fromYear}. Yearly money left for further goals is then {cashFlow.2030.remaining} in {cashFlow.2030.year} and {cashFlow.2031.remaining} in {cashFlow.2031.year}. Your partner's working income stops in {retirement.partner.fromYear}; working money available for further goals is {cashFlow.2032.remaining} in {cashFlow.2032.year}.
parts.costs: The dated-cost saving period uses most of the available yearly money. The later figures follow the stated retirement dates and do not assume pay rises.
parts.check: The car-loan settlement and each retirement date, since these change when working money becomes available.

sections.title: What you own after the changes

parts.does: After the route's opening changes, your net worth is {position.netWorth}.
parts.why: Your home is smaller, the car loan is cleared from savings, the sale repays the home loan, and money is assigned to the dated-cost fund.
parts.gives: What you own would cover what you owe. The difference from today's net worth is {vsCurrent.netWorth}.
parts.costs: Selling and buying costs reduce net worth. Cash assigned to the dated-cost fund is committed, even while it remains an asset in the opening balance sheet.
parts.check: The property valuation, settlement figure and transaction costs before relying on the illustration.

parts.does: The main change is the home move and its release of capital for your dated cost.
parts.why: A lower sale price, a dearer replacement home or higher transaction costs would leave less capital for the fund.
parts.gives: The figures describe the priced route under its recorded assumptions. The separate what-if tool is not built, so further stress results have not been produced.
parts.costs: You cannot treat the priced route as evidence that a changed sale price or cost would still meet the goal.
parts.check: Sale price, replacement price, costs and timing are the subjects for further stress testing when that tool is available.

parts.does: This remains a fictional illustration for review.
parts.why: Whether moving home is acceptable matters as much as whether the figures add up.
parts.gives: You can see today's position, the transaction, the dated-cost funding years and the later working-money timeline separately.
parts.costs: Further stress calculations have not been produced because the what-if tool is not built.
parts.check: Whether you would consider moving; a suitable home and actual transaction costs; the dated cost's amount and date; pension statements and retirement dates; and the effect of changed assumptions.
